name: liquid-glass-lab
description: Liquid Glass-inspired UI system with a WebGL2 SDF refraction engine, a refraction test lab, and a Claude skill.

scripts.test: npm run test:refraction && npm run test:web && npm run test:glass
scripts.test:react: cd implementations/react && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build:demo && cd ../../validation && node run-react-smoke.mjs
scripts.skill:zip: cd skill && node -e "require('child_process').execSync(process.platform==='win32'?'powershell Compress-Archive -Force liquid-glass-ui liquid-glass-ui-skill.zip':'zip -qr liquid-glass-ui-skill.zip liquid-glass-ui',{stdio:'inherit'})"
